title: Saving a trace once permanently excludes later appended events
reasoning: Saved traces are tracked solely by pathname. If a resumed session appends events to an existing trace after save_artifacts, subsequent saves exclude that file regardless of its changed contents. The same exclusion also prevents reading its updated token totals. Consequently, later artifacts omit resumed trace events and usage accounting changes depending on whether artifacts were saved.
reproduction: Save artifacts for a trace, append another token_count event to the same trace, and save to a second artifact directory. The updated trace is excluded, and _read_latest_trace_usage cannot see the appended usage.
recommendation: Track trace changes or read offsets rather than treating saved paths as immutable. Keep usage discovery independent of artifact export bookkeeping.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included for saving artifacts between resumed invocations.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise save, append, and save sequences for an existing trace, verifying updated events are exported and usage remains identical with and without intermediate artifact saves.
minimumFixScope: CodexAgent trace discovery, export bookkeeping, and lifecycle coverage.
